match eval_expression(expression) { Ok(result) => HttpResponse::Ok().json(CalcResponse { result: result.to_string() }), Err(_) => HttpResponse::BadRequest().body("Invalid input"), } } fn eval_expression(expression: &str) -> Result { let tokens = tokenize(expression)?; let rpn = shunting_yard(&tokens)?; evaluate_rpn(&rpn) } fn tokenize(expression: &str) -> Result, &'static str> { let mut tokens = Vec::new(); let mut num_buf = String::new(); for c in expression.chars() { if c.is_digit(10) || c == '.' { num_buf.push(c); } else if "+-*/()".contains(c) { if !num_buf.is_empty() { tokens.push(num_buf.clone()); num_buf.clear(); } tokens.push(c.to_string()); } else if c.is_whitespace() { continue; } else { return Err("Invalid character"); } } if !num_buf.is_empty() { tokens.push(num_buf); } Ok(tokens) } fn shunting_yard(tokens: &[String]) -> Result, &'static str> { let mut output = Vec::new(); let mut operators = Vec::new(); let precedence: HashMap<&str, i32> = [("+", 1), ("-", 1), ("*", 2), ("/", 2)].iter().cloned().collect(); for token in tokens { if let Ok(_) = token.parse::() { output.push(token.clone()); } else if "+-*/".contains(token.as_str()) { while let Some(op) = operators.last() { if "+-*/".contains(op.as_str()) && precedence[op.as_str()] >= precedence[token.as_str()] { output.push(operators.pop().unwrap()); } else { break; } } operators.push(token.clone()); } else if token == "(" { operators.push(token.clone()); } else if token == ")" { while let Some(op) = operators.last() { if op == "(" { operators.pop(); break; } else { output.push(operators.pop().unwrap()); } } } } while let Some(op) = operators.pop() { output.push(op); } Ok(output) } fn evaluate_rpn(rpn: &[String]) -> Result { let mut stack = Vec::new(); for token in rpn { if let Ok(num) = token.parse::() { stack.push(num); } else if "+-*/".contains(token.as_str()) { if stack.len() < 2 { return Err("Invalid expression"); } let b = stack.pop().unwrap(); let a = stack.pop().unwrap(); let result = match token.as_str() { "+" => a + b, "-" => a - b, "*" => a * b, "/" => { if b == 0.0 { return Err("Division by zero"); } a / b }, _ => return Err("Invalid operator"), }; stack.push(result); } } if stack.len() == 1 { Ok(stack.pop().unwrap()) } else { Err("Invalid expression") } } #[actix_web::main] async fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> { HttpServer::new(|| { App::new() .service(calculate) }) .bind("0.0.0.0:5000")? .run() .await }
